title: Fix sendEvent crash guard — add try/catch to prevent Node.js process crash
description:
**Source:** Internal audit Sprint 60 (2026-07-11) finding P0-002

`sendEvent` in `MineflayerAdapter/index.js` (line ~122-129) has no error handling. If the WebSocket is destroyed (ERR_STREAM_DESTROYED), the send throws and crashes the Node.js process. The C# side gets a WebSocket close event but has no visibility into the cause — the error is invisible.

**Recommendation:** Wrap `agentSocket.send()` in try/catch. Log the error via `logStructured`. Do not rethrow — the event is best-effort. Also consider checking `agentSocket.readyState` before sending.
